sql: select count(*) as created_7d, count(*) filter (where status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout')) as settled_7d, round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from (closed_at - created_at))/3600.0)::numeric,1) as p50_hours_to_close, round(percentile_cont(0.9) within group (order by extract(epoch from (closed_at - created_at))/3600.0)::numeric,1) as p90_hours_to_close, count(*) filter (where closed_at is not null and closed_at > now() - interval '24 hours') as closed_last_24h from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
